source_note: Verified Geography Form Two scheme of work for Term I and Term II (TIE curriculum). Week rows reused verbatim so offline and AI scheme generation reproduce the educator-verified strategies, resources and assessment tools. The inline lesson-count ('(N lessons)') from each Specific Activity is also recorded in the Periods field so weekly rows carry the right lesson load.
